statement.zh: Graham 1934《Hanchow 发掘初步报告》记录月亮湾/广汉地点的首次科学发掘。
statement.en: Graham 1934 ‘Hanchow’ preliminary report records the first scientific excavation at the Yueliangwan/Guanghan locus.
